races.race_name: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: What A Girl Wants
runners.spotlight: Promise in three 5f runs in Ireland in the spring; well beaten in the Albany at Royal Ascot on yard debut but bounced back when fourth of eight in 6f Newmarket Listed race (good to firm) seven weeks ago, no extra late on and shaping as if this return to a stiff 5f may be ideal; sets a good standard for the rest to aim at.
runners.comment: Fairly useful form, including fourth in 6f Listed last time; sets a good standard

runners.name: Not My Type
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly who made a winning start to her career over 5f at Sandown (good to firm) three weeks ago; the third from that race has won since; 7lb penalty but almost certainly has more to offer for top stable.
runners.comment: Sandown debut winner for top yard and form has been franked; definitely more to come

runners.name: Flower Youmzain
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in maidens at Pontefract (6f, good) and Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in June without achieving a great deal; capable of better at some point.
runners.comment: Signs of ability in two maidens in June without achieving a great deal

runners.name: Classyfied
runners.spotlight: Advertise filly and the second foal of a fair 6f AW winner; the mount of David Allan from the yard's two debutantes but the market is likely the best guide to expectations
runners.comment: A watching brief is advised on debut unless betting hints otherwise

runners.name: Empress Princess
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros daughter of No Nay Never; stable has had a first-time-out 2yo winner here in the Jaber Abdullah silks this season; would need considering if the betting speaks in her favour.
runners.comment: No Nay Never filly whose stable has had first-time-out 2yo winner here this year

runners.name: Queen Of Tears
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner half-sister to 6f winner The Untamed (RPR 80); dam 6f 2yo winner (95); David Allan is on the yard's other newcomer but she's bred to have a future and is worth a second look in the betting.
runners.comment: David Allan on yard's other newcomer but she's bred to have a future

races.race_name: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lairy Mary
runners.spotlight: Her mark appears about right based on her two nursery efforts last month but she now returns to the scene of her fast-ground claiming success in May; also has a handy draw so there are reasons to be hopeful.
runners.comment: Held in nurseries last twice but did win a claimer over C&D earlier in year

runners.name: Concert Pitch
runners.spotlight: Bumped into useful types when runner-up in maidens Hamilton (5f, good to soft) and over C&D (good to firm) in June/July and made a good start to his nursery career when beaten only a neck in a 0-75 at Carlisle (5f, good) on Tuesday; pulled just over 3l clear of the third at Carlisle and is the one to beat if turned out again quickly.
runners.comment: Clear of third when close second on Carlisle nursery debut on Tuesday; the one to beat

runners.name: Mardy Bum
runners.spotlight: Good third on nursery debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) but well-held third third over 6f there a week later and she trailed throughout at Thirsk (6f again; Enemy Action ahead of her) since.
runners.comment: Good third on nursery debut but two lesser runs since; drawn widest

runners.name: Mrs Mole
runners.spotlight: Has reached the frame on two of her three starts; looked suited by the drop to 6f (led for long way) when third in Lingfield maiden and it could be that the minimum trip sees her in an even better light on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Led for long way over 6f latest and drop to 5f could suit now handicapping

runners.name: Enemy Action
runners.spotlight: Made a sound start to his nursery career when fourth to stablemate Lady Dublin over 6f at Thirsk (good to firm) three weeks ago, albeit not obviously shaping as if crying out for a drop back to 5f; wears first-time cheekpieces; has shown a tendency to start slowly.
runners.comment: Best run when fourth on 6f Thirsk nursery debut, although he again blew start; headgear on

runners.name: Targa
runners.spotlight: Had two runs in nurseries last month, beaten just over 2l when third of seven over 5f at Lingfield (good to firm) latterly; being eased another 2lb can only help but it's not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Beaten just over 2l when third in similar race at Lingfield latest; eased another 2lb

runners.name: Kaiulani Spirit
runners.spotlight: Has hinted at ability on all three 5f starts and the return to a stiff track for nursery debut should suit having been taken off his feet at Catterick latest; also gets first-time blinkers; possible improver.
runners.comment: Possible improver on nursery debut in first-time blinkers

runners.name: Good Fighter
runners.spotlight: Hasn't built on his 5f debut in two subsequent 6f outings but more realistic chance now handicapping at a low level; has shown speed so the return to 5f could help, as may first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: More realistic chance now handicapping at low level; also sports first-time blinkers

runners.name: Articulate
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three 5f outings in recent weeks; more chance in this company but still hard to fancy from 6lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Down the field in three 5f outings and hard to fancy from out of weights

runners.name: Johns Power
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on his first two efforts when keeping on for fourth (Kaiulani Spirit behind in fifth) over 5f at Catterick (good to firm) four weeks ago; the third gave that form a bit of a boost when winning a maiden at Thirsk last week; should be up to making an impact from an opening mark in the mid-50s.
runners.comment: Some promise on his qualifying run at Catterick and has a modest mark to work with

races.race_name: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Ariane Sky
runners.spotlight: Improved to make a winning start to her handicap career over the extended 7f at Ffos Las (good) 16 days ago, making virtually all under Mason Paetel; a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another bold bid.
runners.comment: Improved to make winning nursery debut over an extended 7f latest; bold show likely

runners.name: State Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Best effort when second of 11 in 6f Ripon novice (good) eight weeks ago; mixed messages from that form but her pedigree provides hope that the longer trip could suit now handicapping.
runners.comment: Improved second in 6f Ripon novice in June; up in trip for nursery debut after 56 days off

runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: Led close home to win 7f Musselburgh seller (good) in June; shaped best when short-headed in a C&D novice (good to firm) next time but hasn't reproduced that form when third in two nurseries back at Musselburgh since; needs to bounce back to her best.
runners.comment: 7f seller win; short-headed in C&D nursery next time but below that level twice since

runners.name: Farndale
runners.spotlight: Only modest so far, including last of five (Amantha second) on C&D nursery debut (good to firm) six weeks ago; improvement needed.
runners.comment: Last of five on C&D nursery debut in June and improvement will be needed

runners.name: Wells Fargo Stage
runners.spotlight: Never a serious threat in three qualifying runs over 6f/7f; should stand more chance in nurseries but even an opening mark in the low-50s isn't obviously generous.
runners.comment: More chance in nurseries but even mark in low-50s isn't obviously generous

runners.name: Sovereign Beach
runners.spotlight: Improved when 0.75l third of six on 6f Chepstow nursery debut (good to firm) three weeks ago and her stablemate who won that race followed up back at Chepstow on Sunday; merits plenty of respect off an unchanged mark, particularly as the longer trip may help (dam 1m winner); Ollie Sangster's 6-11 Beverley record is another positive.
runners.comment: Improved third on 6f nursery debut; could be more to come up in trip; yard does well here

runners.name: Yorkshire Dream
runners.spotlight: Well held in three 5f/6f starts in the first half of the summer; gelded ahead of this handicap debut over a longer trip; worth a look in the betting.
runners.comment: Gelded ahead of nursery debut over a longer trip; worth a look in betting

runners.name: Whisper Angel
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three starts last month, including 7f; yard in form but she's best watched unless the betting hints otherwise
runners.comment: Well beaten in three starts last month; best watched unless betting hints otherwise

runners.name: Bonjour Belle
runners.spotlight: Has yet to build on her debut, including a remote fourth of six on last week's 7f Thirsk nursery debut; her claims aren't obvious (mark due to be 3lb lower from weekend).
runners.comment: Remote fourth on last week's 7f Thirsk nursery; her claims aren't obvious

runners.name: Court Legend
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in three qualifying runs over 6f; steps up in trip for nursery debut after five weeks off; all the more interesting if backed.
runners.comment: Signs of ability in three 6f runs; nursery debut; all the more interesting if backed

races.race_name: Connexin Super Fast Sprint Handicap

runners.name: Shazani
runners.spotlight: Made all and held on in tenacious fashion at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; handily drawn but he faces competition for the lead on what is only the second 5f start of his career.
runners.comment: Made all over 6f latest but faces competition for lead on what is just his second 5f start

runners.name: Opal Storm
runners.spotlight: Won this in 2024 and landed a second C&D win when getting up late to see off nine rivals on good to firm last month; can have a line put through her subsequent effort here as she was repeatedly denied a clear run.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024; landed a second C&D success in July and met trouble back here since

runners.name: Ventura Express
runners.spotlight: Has drawn a blank since scoring over C&D in July 2024 but he's on a dangerous mark and latest keeping-on fourth of 17 at York (5f, good to firm) was encouraging with a return to a stiff 5f in mind (all six wins here and at Pontefract).
runners.comment: 0-22 since C&D win in 2024 but latest York fourth decent and this stiff 5f suits better

runners.name: American Bay
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off 2lb higher at Redcar (5f, good to firm) in June; respectable fifth (Castan sixth) of 12 at Thirsk (5f, good) 12 days ago; enters calculations for last year's winning yard.
runners.comment: Nicely handicapped on pick of this year's form and yard won this race last year

runners.name: Jojo Rabbit
runners.spotlight: Made all at Pontefract (5f, good to soft; has won on good to firm) in April; beaten only a head over C&D off 1lb higher in May and arguably unlucky not to go close at the least over C&D again last time, finishing well for fourth having met trouble at a crucial stage; his draw isn't ideal but still respected.
runners.comment: Near miss over C&D in May and looked unlucky when fourth here latest; another to consider
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing XIII & Ruth Carr

runners.name: Good Earth
runners.spotlight: Recorded his 13th turf win when scoring in good style at Haydock (6f, good to firm) in April; respectable fifth of ten at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago but he remains 4lb above the mark he defied at Haydock.
runners.comment: Haydock win in April; fair fifth latest but remains 4lb above mark he defied at Haydock

runners.name: Call To Action
runners.spotlight: Fine runner-up efforts on two of his three starts this year and should give it another good go if fully tuned after ten weeks off.
runners.comment: Runner-up two of three starts this year; should go well if fully tuned after 70 days off
runners.owner: D Scott, Resdev, Capla Dev & L Westwood

runners.name: Castan
runners.spotlight: 5f AW win in April; hasn't reproduced that in four subsequent turf outings but he's back on that last successful mark and has run well here before.
runners.comment: Below par since AW win in April but back on that winning mark and has run well here before

runners.name: Infinity Blue
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 21 starts came at Newmarket (6f, good) in August 2024; also posted a couple of decent placed efforts last August but ended 2025 on a low note and off for ten months ahead of this reappearance; a watching brief is the percentage call.
runners.comment: 1-21 overall and been off for ten months so it's likely best to look elsewhere

runners.name: Holbache
runners.spotlight: Admirable 8yo who recorded his 11th win when surging clear on his reappearance at Catterick (6f, good to firm) under Tom Kiely-Marshall in May; not in the same form when last of five at Nottingham (6f again) since but he's bagged the inside stall on his first Beverley visit and is capable of bouncing back.
runners.comment: 11th win on Catterick return; last of 5 since but capable of bouncing back from good draw

races.race_name: Middle Distance Handicap

runners.name: Wardlaw
runners.spotlight: Raw material is clearly there to win races over 1m4f and beyond, but couldn't have got more wrong at Doncaster latest, overcompensating for having again fluffed the start (beaten 75l); hood replaces blinkers.
runners.comment: Will win races, but yet another slow start at Doncaster latest; hood now given a go.

runners.name: Mr Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Has belied a pedigree not obviously conducive to middle distances in recording two recent near misses, including a neck third at Chester latest (1m4f, good) with three reopposing rivals held; chance off an unchanged mark, assuming no adverse reaction to the debuted cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Neck third at Chester latest (1m4f) with three of today's rivals behind; mark unchanged.

runners.name: Return With Gold
runners.spotlight: 18l behind Mr Moonshine when tenth of ten at Chester latest (1m4f); slight ease still leaves him 4lb above his highest winning mark, and cheekpieces will likely need to inspire a career best.
runners.comment: Well behind Mr Moonshine at Chester latest; likely career best needed; cheekpieces added.

runners.name: Grey Fable
runners.spotlight: Passed by Mr Moonshine close home when fourth at Chester latest, beaten under 1l and clear of Sisterandbrother and Return With Gold; well treated on 2024's peak form, but winless around any course this galloping.
runners.comment: Just behind Mr Moonshine at Chester (goes well there); well treated on 2024 peak efforts.

runners.name: That Darn Cantor
runners.spotlight: Recent step up to 1m4f and fitting of cheekpieces has returned him to the level of his peak 2yo effort, and still had running left at the end of a slightly better Thirsk Class 5 than this last time; chance.
runners.comment: Still staying on late when over 1l third at Thirsk latest (1m4f); among likeliest.

races.race_name: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap

runners.name: Ten Sixty Six
runners.spotlight: All but held on in a 7.5f fillies' maiden here a year ago, and best effort since came when a staying-on C&D fourth two runs back; claims on that, so long as a weakening effort at Hamilton last time is forgiven.
runners.comment: 7.5f maiden near-miss and last month's fair C&D handicap fourth from two visits here.

runners.name: Dumfries
runners.spotlight: Hostage to fortune under his usual running style but defied trouble in running for both 7.5f wins here last year, one at this meeting off today's mark; should be coming to the boil after two staying-on efforts over that same C&D this term, and did win third time out in 2025; very interesting.
runners.comment: Dual 7.5f winner here in 2025, once off today's mark; should be coming to the boil.
runners.owner: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: Penultimate start had presaged an imminent breakthrough, and a first try over the 1m trip her dam won at duly reaped reward at Redcar last week (good to firm; RPR 59); case clear if over that effort; 1lb well in.
runners.comment: Out of a 1m winner and won well switched to that trip last week; 1lb well in here.

runners.name: Harswell River
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in the 7.5f nursery on this card last year, but better than a record of 1-23 might imply and she remains 4lb below her winning mark; likely goaded into overracing last time over a 1m2f trip she's still quite new to, and return to about 1m for now may do no harm.
runners.comment: 4lb below winning mark; possibly goaded into overracing last time; drops back from 1m2f.

runners.name: Copper And Five
runners.spotlight: C&D record read 14224 before June's below-par run, and a foray into classified company since bore no fruit either; wouldn't dismiss outright from this lowest mark he's ever raced off in a handicap, however.
runners.comment: Usually does better here than he managed two runs ago; lowest ever handicap mark.
runners.owner: Mrs Sally Doyle And Mrs Ruth Carr

runners.name: Back From Dubai
runners.spotlight: A repeat of the form of either May's Doncaster 7f win (good to soft) or last September's second over today's C&D (soft) would see him go close; over four years now since his sole win on fast turf, however.
runners.comment: Solid second last autumn on most recent C&D visit, albeit on softer ground than awaits.

runners.name: Royal Sizzler
runners.spotlight: Attainment level in handicaps not clarified by June's weakening 6l fourth here that perhaps owed more to racing wastefully than to the 1m2f (winners at that trip in immediate family); may learn more today.
runners.comment: Didn't settle when a fading fourth on June's handicap debut here (1m2f); may do better.

runners.name: Amarachi
runners.spotlight: Raced on turf only once since June 2025's Yarmouth handicap debut win (6f), going close over just shy of today's trip twice in the winter; no threat on either previous return from a triple-figure number of days out.
runners.comment: Only one turf run since Yarmouth 6f win last year; evidence to suggest she might need run.

runners.name: Sweet Cicely
runners.spotlight: 0-23; struggling to beat many home this turf season, faring no better for a step up to 2m at Redcar last time; others likelier.
runners.comment: Struggling to beat many home this turf season; last of four when tried at 2m latest.

runners.name: Aurora's Doublesix
runners.spotlight: 0-18; more realistic assignment today following last week's Ripon novice tilt, but preceding efforts in handicaps fall some way short of the required; work on from out of the weights.
runners.comment: Too stiff an ask in a Ripon novice last time, but limited appeal here nevertheless.

races.race_name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)

runners.name: Sydney Rock
runners.spotlight: Runner-up all three starts as a juvenile and after a miserable start to this season she was back in form when second again, this time at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) one week ago; still needs to prove herself at 1m, but she finished it off well last time and should be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: Runner-up all three starts last term and back in form when second again latest; new trip

runners.name: Kimeko Glory
runners.spotlight: She has struggled to recapture her 3yo best this term, latterly beaten 7l in a 1m2f Sandown handicap she won readily last year; today's drop back in trip and new cheekpieces could help, however, and this is probably her easiest task for a while; can't be ruled out from a dangerous mark.
runners.comment: Not at best this term; drop back in trip and new cheekpieces may help; can't be ruled out

runners.name: Zipwire
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner but he's yet to score on turf and his fair effort at Windsor (1m) in June was sandwiched by two moderate ones at 1m2f; return to this trip is a positive and there's nothing wrong with his mark but others hold more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Yet to score on turf and it was only a fair effort on his last go at 1m
runners.owner: The 19th Hole Syndicate & J S Moore

runners.name: Thiscouldbefun
runners.spotlight: Exposed filly who has been in patchy form this year, including when beating one home over 1m2f at Windsor last month; drop back in trip will help, and she's 3lb below her last winning mark, but others look safer.
runners.comment: Exposed filly who has been in patchy form this year; others look safer
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

runners.name: Amathus
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner who likes it here, as evidenced by him winning an amateur riders' handicap (7f) for the second year in succession last time; stays this trip and has to enter calculations.
runners.comment: 9yo who won third race here (7f) last time; stays this trip and has to enter calculations

runners.name: Decalogue
runners.spotlight: Took a decent step forward on his second handicap start when third at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last Thursday; missed the break that day so better can be expected again if getting away on terms; player in his fresh cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Unexposed and took a decent step forward latest; player in his fresh cheekpieces

runners.name: Ebn Sabt
runners.spotlight: Beat a rival for the first time this term when eighth of nine at Ffos Las nine days ago; still finished 16l adrift and he's impossible to recommend.
runners.comment: Beat a rival for the first time this term at Ffos Las nine days ago; was still 16l adrift

races.race_name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (Qual) (GBB/IRE Inc)

runners.name: Tiora Time
runners.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; built on promising debut when justifying good support with convincing win at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; 7lb penalty is largely wiped out by her allowance and she holds strong claims.
runners.comment: Convincing win 12 days ago; 7lb penalty largely wiped out by allowance; strong claims

runners.name: Flooding
runners.spotlight: Lively in the market and she did best of the newcomers when second of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago; that bare form already puts her right in the picture and improvement is on the cards.
runners.comment: Bare form of debut second of ten already puts her in the picture; improvement on the cards

runners.name: Polgaria
runners.spotlight: Improved on her very moderate debut when beaten 7l at Lingfield (7f, AW) nine days ago; that still leaves her someway adrift of the required standard.
runners.comment: Improved on moderate debut latest; that still leaves her someway adrift of what's required

runners.name: All Angels
runners.spotlight: 8,500gns foal, £55,000 yearling; missed the break and looked green on her debut when sixth of eight at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; yard's juveniles often take a good step forward from their introduction so no surprise to see her more competitive this time.
runners.comment: £55,000 yearling; green on debut but yard's juveniles often take a good step forward

runners.name: Virtue Humble
runners.spotlight: 66-1 when she finished ninth of 11 on her introduction at Newbury (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; will need a firm step forward.
runners.comment: 66-1 when ninth of 11 on her introduction four weeks ago; firm step forward needed

races.race_name: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Reformation
runners.spotlight: 130,000gns yearling; already-gelded son of No Nay Never; half-brother to winners Maybe Not (7f-1m including AW; RPR 95) and Glencalvie (1m including AW; 78); dam 7f/8.6f AW winner (91), half-sister to smart winners English Oak (7f/1m) and Forest Of Dean (1m2f Group 3); faces just one rival on his introduction and he's in good hands; market should prove telling.
runners.comment: 130,000gns yearling; already-gelded son of No Nay Never; market should prove telling
runners.owner: M Blencowe & & Mrs R M Gorell

runners.name: Serenetta
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her November debut (good to soft) when taking Kempton novice (also 7f, AW) one month later; half-sister to connections' Group 1 winners Bluestocking and Qirat whose trainer hoped could progress into a Pattern performer in a spring stable tour; has been found a cracking opportunity to start out on that journey.
runners.comment: Confirmed debut turf promise with novice win (7f, AW) in December; hard to oppose

races.race_name: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Clarity
runners.spotlight: Similar form when beaten around 4l in Kempton novice (6f, AW) last month and valuable Goodwood maiden (7f, good to firm; Siena Storm 2l ahead, Orchard Hatches behind) three weeks later; goes up in trip again and she's probably still getting the hang of things; can be expected to do better.
runners.comment: 2l behind Siena Storm at Goodwood a fortnight ago; likely still getting the hang of things

runners.name: Siena Storm
runners.spotlight: 600,000euros breeze-up buy who did best of those coming from off the pace when fourth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm; Clarity fifth, Orchard Hatches eighth) on her introduction a fortnight ago; holds Pattern-race entries and connections took this with a future Group 2 winner in 2024; a mile will suit on breeding and she's probably the one to beat.
runners.comment: Had Clarity & Orchard Hatches behind when promising debut fourth; probably the one to beat

runners.name: Caelan's Rose
runners.spotlight: By Ulysses; sister to 9.4f/1m4f winner Lia Rose (including AW/Sweden; RPR 76), half-sister to four winners including Jewel In My Crown (1m-1m3f including AW; 101), Ruby Wedding (1m3f; 87) and Rosa Gold (1m-1m2f; 82); dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Listed winner (107); looks the yard second string on jockey bookings but still requires a market check on her introduction.
runners.comment: By Ulysses; looks yard second string on jockey bookings but still requires a market check

runners.name: Indian Lights
runners.spotlight: Showed signs of inexperience before finishing fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on her debut four weeks ago; that initial effort already gives her solid claims and runner-up Flooding (declared for 6:04 on this card) may give the form a boost; pedigree suggests this new trip may suit and she's a player.
runners.comment: Signs of inexperience when fourth on debut; that effort gives her solid claims

runners.name: Orchard Hatches
runners.spotlight: 125-1 when she did quite a bit wrong before finshing eighth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm; Siena Storm fourth, Clarity fifth) a fortnight ago; looks sure to prove better than that at some point, but might be one for further down the line.
runners.comment: 125-1 when behind Siena Storm and Clarity on debut; can improve but may need more time

races.race_name: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Counter Intuitive
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who won Thirsk novice (good) in June and made a winning handicap debut at Newmarket (also 1m4f, good to firm) one month later; looked better the further she went last time and a 4lb rise shouldn't stop her being very competitive in the hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who is on a hat-trick after novice and h'cap wins; leading contender

runners.name: Ruby Wedding
runners.spotlight: In-form filly who scraped home at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm) in June before going fairly close at Newcastle (12.5f, AW) one month later; goes up in grade again but she's getting better and needs respecting.
runners.comment: In-form filly who won penultimate start and went fairly close latest; player

runners.name: Green Sky
runners.spotlight: Rampant since joining Rod Millman and she was 7lb well in when completing a July hat-trick at Newbury (13.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; runs off her revised rating this time but this drop back in trip should be no bother and she needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: 7lb well in when landing hat-trick last time; revised rating but needs taking seriously

runners.name: Rossa Raheen
runners.spotlight: Bar a soft-ground blip she's been in good form since switched to handicaps and she made the breakthrough over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; like stablemate Liveinthelight she goes up in grade but similarly has her best days ahead of her and warrants consideration.
runners.comment: In good form and she made the breakthrough over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; respected

runners.name: Liveinthelight
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who is only a neck away from being on a five-timer, with two wins at Ffos Las supplemented by success at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; those wins came in small fields and this is a hike in grade but she's still a player; one of two for a yard that's ticking along nicely.
runners.comment: Won three of her last four; goes up in grade but she must be considered
runners.owner: Lady Bamford , Mrs Collins & Bv Sangster

runners.name: Gloryous
runners.spotlight: Tends to lead; won twice last summer and she also went close here (again 1m2f, good) in October; yet to match latter form in two starts this term and now tries a new trip.
runners.comment: Won twice last summer but others arrive in better form; tries a new trip

runners.name: Percy's Daydream
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive filly who made the running when taking 1m2f handicaps (good to firm) at Doncaster and Beverley this year; didn't get the breaks at Pontefract last time and this return to 1m4f is no reason to rule her out.
runners.comment: She's won twice (1m2f) this year and this return to 1m4f is no reason to rule her out

races.race_name: Venture Security Handicap

runners.name: Supplicate
runners.spotlight: After an encouraging debut she made good strides in three subsequent starts, winning a maiden (1m, AW), Bath novice and Nottingham handicap (also 1m2f, good to firm); handicapper couldn't go overboard after that latter success a fortnight ago; leading contender in bid for the four-timer.
runners.comment: Won last three including 1m2f Nottingham handicap latest; leading contender

runners.name: Seven Sisters
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who won Doncaster novice (1m2f, good to firm) in June and it was a solid handicap debut when fairly close fourth at Chester (10.5f, good) three weeks ago; unraced at two and it will be disappointing if we've already seen the best of her.
runners.comment: Unexposed and it was a solid h'cap debut when fourth latest; unraced at two; can do better

runners.name: On The Inlet
runners.spotlight: Looked good when winning twice on AW (1m/7f) in the spring but his form on turf doesn't bear comparison, albeit his last start on grass came in a warm handicap; proved underwhelming on AW last time and he now tackles a new trip with a question to answer.
runners.comment: Yet to match his AW form on turf and he now tackles a new trip with a question to answer

runners.name: Storm Point
runners.spotlight: Made a winning handicap debut on AW (7f) in April and he doubled his tally when landing Newbury handicap (1m, good to soft) in June; underperformed on good to firm over latter C&D last month and he was taken out due to quick conditions at Glorious Goodwood three weeks later; goes up in trip with a query surrounding this forecast ground.
runners.comment: Two-time handicap winner (7f/1m) but he's yet to prove himself on quick ground

runners.name: Sudbury Hill
runners.spotlight: Sauntered home in a June juvenile hurdle and, after getting turned over in similar event at Stratford six days later, he got up late to land four-runner handicap over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; first-time cheekpieces worn that day are retained and he's respected up 3lb.
runners.comment: Got up late to win four-runner C&D event last time; respected up 3lb in retained headgear

races.race_name: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase

runners.name: Killeemore Lad
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort; rated 112 over hurdles; was in the process of running a cracker when returning from 745 days off on his chasing debut at Wexford before falling at the last; pulled a long way clear with one other at Roscommon 13 days later when runner-up (2m1f, soft); this is another run relatively quickly but he looks like he has improved for fences.
runners.comment: Rated 112 over hurdles but looks like he has improved for fences; chance

runners.name: Luker's Tipple
runners.spotlight: Has hit top form recently; followed up an easy win in a weak Downpatrick maiden hurdle (2m2f, good) with success in a Sligo novice contest (2m2f, good); his rating of 120 over hurdles is the best on offer here but he must transfer it to fences on this chasing bow.
runners.comment: Has hit top form recently; holds best hurdles rating but must bring it to fences

runners.name: Missus Beeton
runners.spotlight: Bagged back-to-back mares' handicap hurdles in January/March at Down Royal and Leopardstown at 2m1f/2m3f on soft ground; form has dipped in three runs since, including when beaten 18.5l at Galway last time (2m1f, good); cheekpieces return and the tongue tie is new; one of the top rated over hurdles for this chasing bow but needs to bring her best.
runners.comment: Form has dipped in recent runs; good hurdles rating in this company but needs best

runners.name: Playtime
runners.spotlight: Flat winner is 1-11 over hurdles, having been successful in a Leopardstown maiden hurdle in March (2m, soft to heavy); good runner-up finish to the smart Switch From Diesel in a Punchestown novice hurdle in June was his best run since (2m1f, good); makes chasing debut now and his hurdles rating of 115 gives him a shout but his recent runs have been a bit below his best.
runners.comment: His hurdles rating of 115 gives him a shout on this chasing bow but below best recently

runners.name: Tell Us This
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner got off the mark over fences for the first time at the eighth attempt at the Galway festival (2m2f, good); 4lb penalty for that could prove pivotal and his overall form doesn't suggest that a follow-up is guaranteed; trainer won this race last year though.
runners.comment: Off the mark at eighth attempt over fences latest; form suggests follow up not guaranteed

runners.name: Cappa Hill
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps at Cork (2m1f, good) and Tipperary (2m, good to yielding) in August/October; hasn't hit same heights since; unplaced in points and switch to chasing didn't bring improvement at Killarney last time when beaten 28l.
runners.comment: Chasing debut was poor when beaten 28l last time; improvement needed

races.race_name: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase

runners.name: Juke Hill
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; took well to fences when just run out of it late in a beginners' at Wexford in June; blinkers stay on and he looks like he will rate higher over fences compared to his hurdles rating of 102; interesting.
runners.comment: Took well to fences when fourth on chase bow; can rate higher than hurdle OR of 102

runners.name: Le Kap
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise in maidens but serious jumping issues evident on handicap debut at Clonmel in May (2m4f, good to yielding) and his tailed-off finish at Bellewstown last time (3m1f, good) was concerning; rated 107 over hurdles and this yard does wonders with horses over fences so not ruled out on first try chasing with a tongue tie added.
runners.comment: Tailed off last time but stable does wonders with chasers so not ruled out with tongue tie

runners.name: Kasper Hauser
runners.spotlight: Rated 108 over hurdles; gained a first success at the 12th attempt over hurdles in a weak Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time (2m3f, good); he's in good form for his chasing debut but others are more appealing.
runners.comment: 1-12 over hurdles with win coming in weak m'den latest; in form but others more appealing
runners.owner: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate

runners.name: Frankie's Freebie
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner took the runner-up spot at Punchestown (2m3f, good to yielding) and Roscommon (2m5f, good) before running below his best at Galway (2m6f, good); ignoring his last run he's in good form, he has a healthy hurdles rating of 110 and he has a point background, so there's a lot to like.
runners.comment: Point winner has healthy hurdles rating of 110 and was in good form until poor run latest

runners.name: Coded Welder
runners.spotlight: Placed in a point before falling in his second; 0-9 over hurdles but some okay runs in defeat; runner-up in a Cork handicap hurdle off 105 on stable debut in May; didn't match that in two subsequent outings; could do better over fences; not dismissed.
runners.comment: 0-9 over hurdles but some okay runs in defeat; placed in point; may do better over fences

runners.name: Happy Me
runners.spotlight: Is 0-16 over hurdles and rated 100 in that sphere; nonetheless, his 9l fifth of nine at Killarney last month was one of his better efforts (2m5f, good); fences need to bring improvement.
runners.comment: 0-16 over hurdles and rated 100 in that sphere; fences need to bring improvement

runners.name: Mephisto
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a purple patch last summer, winning three handicap hurdles on the bounce at 2m5f-2m7f on good ground; generally struggled since and his latest two runs have been fairly dismal; returns to chasing for the first time since 2024, when he didn't set things alight in three beginners'.
runners.comment: Enjoyed purple patch last summer but struggled since; 2024 chase runs were moderate

runners.name: Rattledelatch
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper and four hurdle starts, the latest on handicap debut; mark of 97 over hurdles is possibly flattering so work to do on chasing bow.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a bumper and four hurdles; OR of 97 looks flattering; work to do
runners.owner: John Joseph Flynn & Conor Lannen & Mrs Miriam Queally

runners.name: Burru
runners.spotlight: Rated 100 after five runs over fences; the latest of those was a positive third in a Roscommon handicap chase in August last year (2m6f, yielding) off 99; made winning stable debut in a Killarney handicap hurdle in May (2m4f, good to yielding); tailed off at Ballinrobe last time; most experienced of these but others probably more talented.
runners.comment: Rated 100 after five runs over fences; most experienced but others more talented

races.race_name: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: I'm All In
runners.spotlight: Three starts in academy hurdles on softer ground than this; best run when in second place and unseating at the last at Cork on debut; on first run of the year, was tailed off at the same venue last time; trainer also runs Noble Rocco.
runners.comment: Best of four efforts came on debut in academy hurdle; tailed off on return latest

runners.name: Spanish Rising
runners.spotlight: Second in a 1m2f Flat maiden at Ripon last year when trained by owner's son; well beaten in three Flat starts for current yard, but there was promise in his fourth of 15 on hurdling bow at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); in the mix if building on that.
runners.comment: Promise in fourth on hurdling bow latest when leaving poor Flat form behind; in the mix

runners.name: Rosarian
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Naas in December, but better in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle on good ground last month when taking the runner-up spot; entitled to improve on that as it came after a 221-day break and if she does she won't be far away.
runners.comment: Runner-up back from a break in a m'den latest; not far away with normal improvement

runners.name: Really Truly
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George filly; fifth foal; sister to winners Nitty Gritty (2m4f hurdle) and Sky Grove (2m hurdle), half-sister to bumper winner Lionnar; dam unraced sister to useful bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Level Neverending; hooded for debut but entitled to respect given the trainer.
runners.comment: Sister to two hurdle winners; hooded for debut but respected given the trainer

runners.name: Noble Rocco
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; well beaten in a bumper at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good); just slight improvement at Sligo when sent over hurdles (2m2f, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper; just slight improvement over hurdles latest; others preferred

runners.name: Johnny Rambo
runners.spotlight: Outran 40-1 odds when a fine second of 17 on debut in a Clonmel maiden hurdle (2m1f, good) despite jumping badly right at second obstacle; proved that was no fluke when winning a 2m Kilbeggan bumper 11 days later; fell at the sixth back over hurdles at Cork last time; must carry a penalty for his bumper win.
runners.comment: Outran odds when second on debut and won a bumper next time; penalised for that

runners.name: Folk Warrior
runners.spotlight: Yet to trouble the judge in seven Flat runs; well beaten off 93 on his handicap hurdle debut at Kilbeggan last time (2m, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: Well beaten off 93 on h'cap hurdle debut latest; others preferred

runners.name: Faerie Tales
runners.spotlight: Has looked limited on the Flat, beating few rivals in four starts; tailed off at Limerick last time; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Has looked limited in four Flat starts; hard to fancy

runners.name: John Gun
runners.spotlight: Gelded son of the German-bred stallion Bathyrhon; first foal; dam French 1m winner, half-sister to German 1m Listed winner; market best guide.
runners.comment: Dam French 1m winner; market best guide

runners.name: Devine Genius
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden was pulled up at 300-1 on his hurdling bow at Cork (2m2f, good); hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Modest Flat m'den was PU at 300-1 on hurdling bow; hard to fancy

runners.name: Green Grass
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Kilbeggan on debut at 66-1; unlikely.
runners.comment: Tailed off at Kilbeggan on debut at 66-1; unlikely

runners.name: Pinkarizon
runners.spotlight: Is 0-8 on the Flat in Britain; pulled up in three of four starts over hurdles and in the other he was beaten 90l; impossible to fancy.
runners.comment: PU in three of four starts and beaten 90l in the other; impossible to fancy

races.race_name: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Dairy Force
runners.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner two years ago for former yard; has been consistent in defeat lately for this stable at around this trip and should run well again.
runners.comment: Maiden winner two years ago has been consistent in defeat lately and should run well

runners.name: Churchwarden
runners.spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in 2024 for John McConnell; came back to form in first-time blinkers to easily win on the Flat here over 1m4f last time; has to be respected back hurdling assuming the blinkers have the desired effect again.
runners.comment: Back to form in first-time blinkers to win on Flat here last time; respected back hurdling

runners.name: Rightfolksplease
runners.spotlight: Downpatrick hurdle winner in 2024 for Paul Flynn; came back from a long absence for this yard with a close second over hurdles at Wexford; got off the mark over fences since at the same track; should go well.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner in 2024; off the mark over fences for new yard last time; should go well

runners.name: Palace Boy
runners.spotlight: One-time useful dual-purpose sort when trained in UK; however, has been poor on his last three runs (two over hurdles) and others preferred.
runners.comment: One-time useful sort has been poor on his last three hurdle runs and others preferred

runners.name: Kome Dans Un Reve
runners.spotlight: Hints of ability in maidens but has to improve plenty from handicap debut at Wexford last time when beaten 24l.
runners.comment: Hints of ability in maidens but has to improve plenty from handicap debut last time

runners.name: Claude
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien last year; similar runs in defeat at Killarney and Galway lately so has to find more even dropped 2lb.
runners.comment: Similar runs in defeat at Killarney and Galway lately so has to find more even dropped 2lb

races.race_name: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle

runners.name: Master Haku
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m Kilbeggan maiden hurdle and bounced back from two lesser runs over further to take a Market Rasen novice over this trip; this is more competitive but has a chance.
runners.comment: Won a Market Rasen novice over this trip; this is more competitive but has a chance

runners.name: Butch Coolidge
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle over 2m6f here in May; a decent run in a Downpatrick novice since but was beaten 32l there last time; has a lot to do in this company on these terms.
runners.comment: Was beaten 32l at Downpatrick last time; has a lot to do in this company on these terms

runners.name: Holy Joe
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; won a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle and added a Perth novice over 2m4f since; this is more competitive but has to be considered.
runners.comment: Won a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle and a Perth novice over 2m4f; this is more competitive

runners.name: Mr Master Mac
runners.spotlight: Sligo bumper winner last year took a Downpatrick maiden hurdle over 2m3f in May; improved from his handicap debut at the same track when runner-up over 3m at Galway last time; can run well again.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over 2m3f was runner-up over 3m at Galway last time; can run well again

runners.name: Siege Of Carthage
runners.spotlight: Was a wide-margin winner of a Limerick maiden hurdle over this trip but was poor in a Galway novice since so has to rebound.
runners.comment: Winner of a Limerick maiden hurdle over this trip but was poor in a Galway novice since

runners.name: Lureka Du Noyer
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a 2m Limerick maiden hurdle in May and was a solid second in a Ballinrobe novice last time over 2m1f; stayed this trip in France so has to be considered for a top local yard.
runners.comment: Won a maiden and 2nd in a novice over shorter; stays this trip so has to be considered

runners.name: Early Dawning
runners.spotlight: Was third in a valuable Fairyhouse restricted bumper on debut last year; lesser bumper run in January; belied inexperience to win on hurdles debut at Killarney over this trip; there should be more to come and is a big player.
runners.comment: Won on hurdles debut at Killarney over this trip; should be more to come and a big player

races.race_name: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Double Power
runners.spotlight: Maiden ran well enough on second handicap start at Wexford last time but was still beaten 16l; needs a fair bit more off 2lb lower.
runners.comment: Beaten 16l at Wexford last time and needs a fair bit more off 2lb lower

runners.name: Pure Logic
runners.spotlight: Maiden showed promise in four bumpers in 2024 and in two maiden hurdles last year; hit and miss this year and has to rebound from two poor runs.
runners.comment: Promise early in career; hit and miss this year and has to rebound from two poor runs

runners.name: Inchidaly Copper
runners.spotlight: One of his three chase wins came here; has also claimed two hurdle races plus was runner-up in this race last year off 6lb lower;  pulled-up over fences at Galway last time but can bounce back over hurdles.
runners.comment: Second in this race last year off 6lb lower; needs a bit more off this mark but go well

runners.name: Arctic Piper
runners.spotlight: Was regressive over hurdles over the winter in testing ground; fell on stable/chasing debut last time; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Regressive over hurdles; fell on stable/chasing debut last time; others make more appeal

runners.name: Princess Felicia
runners.spotlight: Third in a Clonmel handicap over this trip on debut for this yard last October; has a shout if she can repeat that after a break.
runners.comment: Third in a Clonmel handicap over this trip last October; has a shout if can repeat that

runners.name: Talas Kera
runners.spotlight: Has shown a hint of ability in bumpers and over hurdles but was beaten a long way in a Wexford handicap last time so others preferred.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a Wexford handicap last time so others preferred

runners.name: Diamond Secret
runners.spotlight: Best handicap run came when beaten only 9l at Kilbeggan over 15.5f; carried out early at Killarney since; blinkers added today and should stay this trip; a player.
runners.comment: Beaten only 9l at Kilbeggan; carried out early at Killarney since; blinkers on; a player

runners.name: Maxicourt
runners.spotlight: Maiden was a close third at Cork last month over 2m1f but was below that level since over the same C&D; has to rebound back up in trip.
runners.comment: Third at Cork last month over 2m1f but was below that level since over the same C&D

runners.name: Youknowme
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run at Kilbeggan over 3m but has to rebound from a poor effort over this trip at Killarney.
runners.comment: Not a bad run at Kilbeggan but has to rebound from a poor effort at Killarney

runners.name: The Ducks Walk
runners.spotlight: Point winner on soft ground ran his best race over hurdles when fourth over 3m at Kilbeggan last time; this shorter trip might not suit as well but still one to consider.
runners.comment: Fourth over 3m at Kilbeggan last time; this trip might not suit as well but considered

runners.name: Nashville Notions
runners.spotlight: Won a Sligo maiden hurdle last summer but has been mostly below that level since; better last time at Wexford in first-time cheekpieces over 3m; this trip suits better and could go well with the headgear retained.
runners.comment: Better last time at Wexford in first-time c'pieces over 3m; this trip suits; can go well

runners.name: Keep The Head
runners.spotlight: Mild promise in bumpers but not much over hurdles and isn't easy to make a case for her.
runners.comment: Mild promise in bumpers but not much over hurdles and isn't easy to make a case for her

runners.name: Taketwotoone
runners.spotlight: Ran her best race over hurdles when fourth in heavy ground here in 2025; not a bad run at Cork last time over 2m1f; a squeak if staying this trip.
runners.comment: Has run well here; not a bad run at Cork last time over 2m1f; a squeak if staying the trip

runners.name: The Cobblers Wife
runners.spotlight: Was beaten 20l over C&D in April but pulled-up next time at Punchestown; has to find improvement for a new yard.
runners.comment: Beaten 20l over C&D in April but pulled-up next time at Punchestown; new yard

runners.name: Lanzhou
runners.spotlight: First reserve; some promise in points but hasn't progressed in five maiden hurdles; can do better for a local yard on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Hasn't progressed in maidens; can do better for a local yard on handicap bow; reserve

runners.name: Miss Guiry
runners.spotlight: Third in a Cork bumper on debut last year but hasn't built on that over hurdles; is still worth a market check on handicap debut after a break with a tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Worth a market check on handicap debut after a break with a tongue-tie added

races.race_name: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden

runners.name: Dream On Baby
runners.spotlight: A 132-rated hurdler has run well in defeat on the Flat several times including when third over 1m4f here on return last month; however, was poor over hurdles at Galway since and has to rebound; the hood worn then is left off.
runners.comment: Third over 1m4f here last month but poor over hurdles at Galway since and has to rebound

runners.name: Kimy
runners.spotlight: Sole win over hurdles came here in 2024; also ran well on the Flat here when second in a 1m4f maiden when 1.25l ahead of Dream On Baby; well below that level at Galway since so has to rebound.
runners.comment: Second in a 1m4f maiden here last month but well below that level at Galway since

runners.name: Blue Nasturtium
runners.spotlight: Produced a solid effort on debut when a close fourth over 1m4f here last month; with improvement forthcoming she could turn the tables on the placed horses then, Kimy and Dream On Baby; this trip is a question on pedigree, though.
runners.comment: Close fourth over 1m4f here last month; should have improved from that;  trip a question

runners.name: Thisistheway
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner ran her best race in that sphere when third in the Galway Hurdle last time; 7f was too sharp on her last Flat start but has a solid shout on the form of her Listowel fifth over 1m6f last September; big player.
runners.comment: Third in the Galway Hurdle last time; best Flat run when fifth over 1m6f last September

runners.name: Paul's Dream
runners.spotlight: Has been in the form of her career this season, winning handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan before finishing a close third at Galway; now rated 129 in that sphere so has to be respected on Flat debut over a trip that will suit.
runners.comment: Rated 129 over hurdles so has to be respected on Flat debut over a trip that will suit

runners.name: Splashing Out
runners.spotlight: Made all to win over hurdles here in May and bounced back from a poor Galway run to again make all to win a Wexford handicap hurdle six days ago; goes well here and should be a player but likes to get her own way in front.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner here won well at Wexford last time; a player if getting her own way in front

runners.name: Fraher Field
runners.spotlight: Won a Wexford bumper a year ago and has run some solid races in defeat over hurdles since including at Cork last time; beaten 10l in a Leopardstown maiden on sole Flat start; has a bit to find but can be involved.
runners.comment: Maiden over hurdles; beaten 10l in a Leopardstown maiden on sole Flat start; a bit to find
runners.owner: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen

runners.name: Run For Mahler
runners.spotlight: Bumper and dual hurdle winner up to 2m4f (rated 132); the best of two Flat runs when beaten 11l in a 1m4f maiden at Galway last time; this longer trip will suit better and is a big player.
runners.comment: Rated 132 over hurdles; good run in 1m4f maiden at Galway last time and is a big player

runners.name: Silas Marner
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres was tailed-off in a 1m4f Galway maiden on return for a new yard so can't be fancied on that showing.
runners.comment: Tailed-off in a Galway maiden on return for a new yard so can't be fancied on that showing

runners.name: Goodie Girl
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner stays 2m6f in that sphere and rated 110; beaten a long way on sole Flat start at Ballinrobe on return this year but can do better today.
runners.comment: Rated 110 over hurdles; beaten a long way on sole Flat start but can do better today

races.race_name: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap

runners.name: Solar Invincible
runners.spotlight: Dual 5f winner who ran well on his belated return to 6f here 17 days ago, finishing second to Madman despite taking a strong hold; Billy Loughnane has been aboard for both his wins and he now returns.
runners.comment: Dual 5f winner who ran well on his belated return to 6f here 17 days ago

runners.name: Maid In Devon
runners.spotlight: Secured her hat-trick over 6f on soft and fast ground; only 2lb higher than for the last of those wins and it wasn't her fault when losing position quite early last time at Salisbury; needs considering.
runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than when bringing up the hat-trick; feasible excuses last time

runners.name: Koffee And Kale
runners.spotlight: Hasn't looked on that good a mark since winning as a 2yo and ordinary of late, with and without headgear.
runners.comment: Hasn't looked on that good a mark since winning as a 2yo and ordinary of late

runners.name: Two And Two
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f AW race in Ireland on second career start; close fifth on her handicap debut afterwards when tried in a hood that's been absent since (lost her way); sold in July for 3,000gns; others safer.
runners.comment: Steadily regressed after winning in Ireland and sold in July for 3,000gns

runners.name: Madman
runners.spotlight: No match for Maid In Devon three runs back but probably his best form yet when beating Solar Invincible over C&D 17 days ago; 4lb rise is fair enough.
runners.comment: Career-best form in winning here last time and a 4lb rise is fair enough

runners.name: Guernsey Angel
runners.spotlight: Both wins at 5f on Southwell AW; second at Leicester (6f) before a lesser show here 17 days ago when she got warm before the race; could be given another chance.
runners.comment: Got warm before the race here last time and could be given another chance

runners.name: Pilgrim's Progress
runners.spotlight: Back at 5f when going close in a maiden here recently; didn't really threaten in two handicaps prior to that, even when second at Lingfield; should run well but perhaps vulnerable.
runners.comment: Back at 5f when going close in a maiden here recently; 0-2 in handicaps

runners.name: Double Naughty
runners.spotlight: 0-5 for Richard Hannon; successful seasonal/stable debut at Bath (5.5f, good to firm) in May but lesser performances have followed.
runners.comment: Won on yard debut at Bath in May but lesser performances have followed

runners.name: Deadline
runners.spotlight: Best of his three runs was on debut in a 7f novice at Doncaster; subsequent efforts leave him with much to prove on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Last two runs leave him with much to prove on this handicap debut

runners.name: Dark Alley
runners.spotlight: Bath maiden winner last July (5.5f); lightly raced since and pretty poor in his last two starts.
runners.comment: Lightly raced since winning his maiden and pretty poor in his last two starts

runners.name: Court Alert
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has been disappointing since finishing second in a 6f sales race at Newmarket a year ago and was no match for the winner when second in a small field three weeks back (5f; second run in blinkers); makes handicap debut on ninth career start.
runners.comment: Disappointing since his standout run a year ago; now 0-8; handicap debut

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap

runners.name: Legendsoftheland
runners.spotlight: All the better for wind/gelding operations, since producing figures of 3212131; it was by a narrow margin last time and the second disappointed at Chepstow earlier this week, but this 4yo only went up 1lb.
runners.comment: All the better for wind/gelding operations, since producing figures of 3212131

runners.name: Methgal
runners.spotlight: Ran three times as a 2yo for Karl Burke before moving to Ireland, where he won a handicap at Dundalk (7f, AW) in March; joined this yard for 6,000gns and finished second at Yarmouth last month (6-5f; 7f); this is a belated first go at 6f but he has shown early speed.
runners.comment: 1-19; second on recent stable debut and dropping back to 6f could work

runners.name: Rianka
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed winner; contesting only her second handicap (tongue tied for both) when coming from behind to win narrowly at Yarmouth (6f); has to be considered off 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Recent Yarmouth winner and still lightly raced; has to be considered off 3lb higher

runners.name: May Encounter
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden who was no worse for the hood going on when fourth at Salisbury (6f); she would have been closer with a clearer run.
runners.comment: Fourth when hooded at Salisbury and would have been closer with a clearer run

runners.name: Beelzebub
runners.spotlight: Exploited reduced mark on yard debut over C&D but was beaten at odds-on when escaping a penalty at Ffos Las; that was a missed opportunity as he's now 6lb higher.
runners.comment: Missed opportunity last time as his new mark has since kicked in

runners.name: One For Harvey
runners.spotlight: Only 1-15 and recently joined this yard for 5,000gns; didn't get the clearest of runs behind Rianka at Yarmouth but she's unconvincing.
runners.comment: Didn't get the clearest of runs behind Rianka at Yarmouth but she's unconvincing

runners.name: Lahina Bay
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner (5f/6f) who often leads, as was the case when a 4l third of five here ten days ago; that was a bit disappointing.
runners.comment: Often leads, as was the case when a 4l third of five here ten days ago

runners.name: Elmfield
runners.spotlight: Has got closer in each of her runs, last time showing good speed before weakening into third over Bath's extended 5f; doesn't look on a strikingly good mark for handicap debut but still early days for this well-bred filly, and Liam Wright takes off 5lb.
runners.comment: Doesn't look on a strikingly good mark for handicap debut but still early days

runners.name: Beach Partee
runners.spotlight: 3-23; got going too late when runner-up over Brighton's 6f last week; might again hit a flat spot here and may prefer some give underfoot.
runners.comment: Got going too late when runner-up over Brighton's 6f last week; again may hit a flat spot

runners.name: The Feminine Urge
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner for George Scott; signs of getting back on track off her reduced mark last month only to then run poorly last week at Ffos Las.
runners.comment: Two good runs off her reduced mark but then ran poorly last week at Ffos Las

runners.name: Ragaire
runners.spotlight: Looked limited in four Irish runs (5f-7f) for Joseph O'Brien and was sold on for 3,500gns; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Looked limited in four Irish runs (5f-7f) for Joseph O'Brien and was sold on for 3,500gns

races.race_name: ~matchbook Loves Racing Handicap

runners.name: Colourband
runners.spotlight: 1m2f novice winner in April; rather disappointing afterwards but he was then well backed last time at Ayr (1m2f) and beat all bar an Ed Walker improver; 2lb higher with a tongue-tie added and firmly enters the reckoning; should be fine back at 1m.
runners.comment: Beat all bar an improver at Ayr and firmly enters the reckoning

runners.name: Signcastle City
runners.spotlight: A suspicion that 7f might suit him best but after starting slowly he did keep on over 1m at Newbury last time, albeit some 9l off the winner; the handicapper knows all about him.
runners.comment: Reliable in the main but the handicapper knows all about him

runners.name: Too Hot To Tango
runners.spotlight: Came good at 11th attempt from off the pace over C&D in June (3lb lower) and the steady pace wasn't beneficial when last of the four at Epsom; consistent in the main.
runners.comment: C&D winner before found out by a steady pace at Epsom; consistent in the main

runners.name: Clouds Hill
runners.spotlight: The season started well but this front-runner has dropped away tamely in his last three races, albeit strong handicaps; this might not be so challenging and could go well if getting any freedom up front.
runners.comment: Front-runner has dropped away tamely in his last three races; this is less challenging
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Magical Merlot
runners.spotlight: 1m novice winner at two and then gelded; slow starts weren't helping matters this season but raced in touch last time at Lingfield (1m1f) and they all bumped into an improver; could go well.
runners.comment: Raced in touch last time at Lingfield (1m1f) and they all bumped into an improver

runners.name: Knights Gold
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner; cheekpieces applied for final three races and after two thirds (1m) he got no luck in running at Chester; now having first run for Tom Ward and wouldn't rule out.
runners.comment: After two thirds (1m) he got no luck in running at Chester; stable debut

runners.name: Mia Sunshine
runners.spotlight: 2-5 in France, the wins coming at 1m on slow ground; later sold for 130,000euros and since had wind surgery; Billy Loughnane booked but the ground has to be a worry.
runners.comment: 2-5 in France, the wins coming at 1m on slow ground; later sold for 130,000euros

runners.name: Great Chieftain
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row last May (1m, good) and is 7lb below his last winning mark; however, hasn't produced an effort of note since returning to Britain after a stint at Meydan.
runners.comment: Hasn't produced an effort of note since returning to Britain after a stint at Meydan

races.race_name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Waterford Castle
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of chances now (0-10) but he hasn't always enjoyed the best of luck in showing useful form, as was again the case when third in a competitive 1m3f handicap at Glorious Goodwood (first-time blinkers); he's the standout danger to the regally-bred newcomer Partying.
runners.comment: Now 0-10 but he hasn't always enjoyed the best of luck in showing useful form

runners.name: Sax Avoidance
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when completely tailed off at Nottingham last month (1m2f).
runners.comment: 40-1 when completely tailed off at Nottingham last month (1m2f)

runners.name: Partying
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly who cost 4,400,000gns as a yearling; second foal out of a 7f/1m winner (RPR 116), closely related to 1m2f winner Gamrai; bred in accordance with her purchase price and the betting should be highly revealing.
runners.comment: Bred in accordance with her purchase price and the betting should be highly revealing

runners.name: Sergei Breeze
runners.spotlight: Probably achieved little when a remote fourth over C&D last month (300-1).
runners.comment: Probably achieved little when a remote fourth over C&D last month (300-1)

runners.name: Thatcham
runners.spotlight: Beaten 17l behind none other than Bow Echo on his debut in August and the following month beat one home at Southwell (1m), though did get closer; could be one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Well held last season and off since September; he could be one for handicaps

runners.name: Winston's Oath
runners.spotlight: Modest form under National Hunt rules and pretty much tailed off in two 7f novice races.
runners.comment: Modest form under National Hunt rules and pretty much tailed off in two 7f novice races

races.race_name: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Law Court
runners.spotlight: Progressed well this year and was doing all his best work late when mid-division in a big field at Glorious Goodwood (1m); stays 1m1f and he'll probably stay this far; has more to offer.
runners.comment: Doing all his best work late when midfield in a big field at Glorious Goodwood (1m)

runners.name: Auld Toon Loon
runners.spotlight: Close third over C&D in May since when he's been up against it in Class 2s won by a Group horse and then the John Smith's Cup, in which he ran perfectly well for a 66-1 chance; very capable of a big show, though the cheekpieces are new and so too is Donagh Murphy claiming 7lb.
runners.comment: Close third over C&D in May since when he's been up against it in strong Class 2s

runners.name: A Major Payne
runners.spotlight: This is a classier race than he's accustomed to but he's been in fine form since returning from a break and it was comfortable over C&D a month ago; 6lb rise demands another career best but couldn't put it past him.
runners.comment: C&D win last time; 6lb rise demands another career best but couldn't put it past him

runners.name: City Of Poets
runners.spotlight: Both handicap wins have come by narrow margins at Class 3 level and it was a deep Class 2 in which he made no impact last time at Sandown; he's not handicapped out of it if he stays this longer distance (unraced beyond 8.6f).
runners.comment: Tough task latest; he's not handicapped out of it if he stays this longer distance

runners.name: Parlando
runners.spotlight: Had gone badly off the boil but back in a Class 4 he came from behind to score narrowly at Chester (extended 1m2f); if he's turned a corner then likely to have some say off 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Chester winner; if he's turned a corner then likely to have some say off 3lb higher

runners.name: Bold Impact
runners.spotlight: Gina Mangan picked up a 12-day ban when this 4yo was given a lot to do at Ffos Las and he then won by a length under Oisin Murphy here over 1m; has never raced beyond that trip but gives the impression he'll stay this far; up in class off a 5lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Recent winner here over 1m; unraced at this trip; up in class off a 5lb higher mark

runners.name: Box To Box
runners.spotlight: Four of his six wins have been at Chester where he nearly won again when last seen 11 months ago; trip/ground fine and on a fair mark, but market confidence would be welcomed after so long out.
runners.comment: On a fair mark but market confidence would be welcomed after so long out

runners.name: King's Code
runners.spotlight: Five turf wins but has done most of his winning on the AW; surprising to see blinkers back on having won in a visor at Chester last month and then beaten only 4l in a Class 2 handicap at Goodwood; if that doesn't backfire then has possibilities.
runners.comment: Five turf wins but done most of his winning on the AW; surprising to see blinkers back on

races.race_name: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap

runners.name: Mythological Star
runners.spotlight: Carries a penalty for the Ffos Las win (1m, good) as he escapes one for winning an apprentice race over 1m2f here on Monday, which was only by a neck but he had to be switched; competes off the same mark and Billy Loughnane is back on; should have no trouble seeing out this longer trip.
runners.comment: On same mark as for Monday's win here and Billy Loughnane is back on

runners.name: Roker Roar
runners.spotlight: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut at Sandown where he lacked the pace of the front two over 1m2f; this extra yardage can trigger some improvement.
runners.comment: Handicap debut at Sandown where he lacked the pace of the front two over 1m2

runners.name: Impossible Mission
runners.spotlight: Exposed but consistent and dug deep to prevail in a close finish over 1m2f here a month ago (they went steady); every chance off 2lb higher; third over this trip the time before.
runners.comment: Exposed but consistent and dug deep to prevail in close finish over 1m2f here a month ago

runners.name: Aravalli
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who is 3-5 for current yard, all the wins coming on fast ground at Chepstow (1m2f-1m4f); won as she liked last week so could well make light of the penalty.
runners.comment: Won as she liked last week so could well make light of the penalty

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Barry's Boy
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won at Newcastle (1m, AW) in March and was as good as ever when runner-up at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last time; only 1lb higher back on Polytrack and he could make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle in March and was runner-up at Wolverhampton last time; respected

runners.name: Kaaranah
runners.spotlight: Has won at Wolverhampton (9.4f, Tapeta) in four of his last six starts, including a comfortable success from a wide draw three weeks ago; up another 4lb but he still looks feasibly treated and this return to Polytrack should be fine; big player in hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Has won at Wolverhampton in four of his last six runs; big player again in hat-trick bid

runners.name: Barbury Boy
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 in handicaps when scoring at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in June but he flopped with a laboured effort at Sandown (beaten 9l) last month; still lightly raced but he's a been a bit up and down so far and needs to bounce back again.
runners.comment: Won two of his four handicaps but he needs to bounce back after a poor run last time

runners.name: Booziebrunch
runners.spotlight: Got back on the scoresheet with a runaway win over two rivals at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) in June; held in another small-field event at Epsom last time but that was a solid front-running effort behind an improver; still unexposed at this trip and he should be in the mix again back on AW.
runners.comment: Runaway win at Newmarket in June before a creditable second at Epsom; respected

runners.name: Alice De Clare
runners.spotlight: Made a bright start in handicaps, with a second at Beverley followed by 1m2f wins at Yarmouth and Leicester (both on good to firm); still unexposed after only seven starts but she didn't fire on turf here last time and needs to resume her progress back on AW.
runners.comment: Disappointing in hat-trick bid here (turf) last time and she needs to resume her progress

runners.name: Turku
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in novice events at Chelmsford last winter but he failed to beat a rival when 4-1 favourite on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f; cheekpieces added) last month; that was from a wide draw but he hung right and has bit to prove after that disappointing effort; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces.
runners.comment: 4-1 favourite but he finished last of ten on handicap debut last month; bit to prove

runners.name: Jack Sparowe
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run in first-time blinkers at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) in May and he's continued the good work with placed efforts in both subsequent runs (AW/turf); still looks on a workable mark and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.
runners.comment: In-form 8yo who could be a big factor if this sets up for his closing style

runners.name: City Of God
runners.spotlight: Won with cheekpieces added at Chelmsford (1m, Polytrack) in February but that was a seller and he's been well back in handicaps in three runs for his current yard; continues to drop down the weights but he's untried at this trip and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Won a Chelmsford seller (1m, AW) in February but he's been well back in handicaps since

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Aljoon
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience on his debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) and duly stepped forward when a front-running second of ten at Catterick (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; sets the standard but he does have the widest stall to negotiate.
runners.comment: Green on debut but improved for a 7th furlong when 2nd at Catterick latest; sets standard

runners.name: Gravastar
runners.spotlight: Given a BHA rating of 57 after three runs at up to 7f; she needs a big step forward if she is to take this.
runners.comment: BHA rated 57 after her three runs at up to 7f; a big step forward is required

runners.name: Northern Exposure
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-brother to 7f/1m winner Born A Rebel (RPR 75); dam 1m AW winner (76), half-sister to useful 6f/7f winner De Bruyne Horse (including 2yo Listed); hooded for debut; 7lb claimer on board.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 7f/1m winner Born A Rebel (RPR 75); dam an AW winner; hooded for debut

runners.name: Brushstroke
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to winners Mister Mojito (7f/1m including AW; RPR 81) and Bella Fortunata (6f AW 2yo; 49); dam 5f AW winner (73); starts out at a realistic level and he looks worth a market check.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two winners out of a 5f AW winner; worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Huwa Baree
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; sixth foal; closely related to 11.6f winner Three Priests (RPR 107), half-brother to three winners including Five Towns (7f/1m including 2yo/AW/US stakes; 111) and First Principle (1m/8.6f including 2yo/AW; 102); dam US 1m3f turf Grade 3 winner (100); looks the part on paper and he's a newcomer to take seriously.
runners.comment: Has four winning siblings and dam was a Grade 3 winner; a newcomer of some interest

runners.name: Mr Badger
runners.spotlight: 14,000gns yearling; ninth foal; brother to 7f winner Name The Day (RPR 72), half-brother to winners Wedding Date (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; 93), Amicia (French 7f; 75) and Secret Potion (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; 74); dam placed over 6f on AW (53); stable have had a couple of 2yo winners this year so not discounted.
runners.comment: 14,000gns yearling with four winning siblings; worth a market check

runners.name: Lucky Larry
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in two starts (5.7f, good and 7f, AW) in June; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Tailed off in two starts (5.7f, good and 7f, AW) in June; hard to recommend

runners.name: Kiss Cam
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two runs in fillies' only company, recording a peak RPR of 45; improvement essential.
runners.comment: Unplaced in two runs last month; plenty of improvement is required

runners.name: Roberts Legacy
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two 6f runs this summer; today's extra furlong isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Down the field in two 6f runs this summer; today's extra furlong isn't enough to tempt

runners.name: Zonneveld
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two sprint runs on fast turf; easy enough to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Modest form in two sprint runs on fast turf; easy enough to look elsewhere
runners.owner: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner

runners.name: Calendar Boy
runners.spotlight: 22-1 and in need of the experience when down the field in a 6f novice at Salisbury (good to firm) 44 days ago; gelded since; should do better in time and the extra furlong is a plus.
runners.comment: Green when down the field over 6f in June; gelded since; should do much better in time

races.race_name: Emilies 21st Birthday Handicap

runners.name: Quick Quasar
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps/fitting of cheekpieces this spring, second at Southwell before winning at Kempton four days later (both 7f); best run since when fourth of ten in a Class 5 at Wolverhampton two weeks ago (blinkered first time); respected back down into a Class 6.
runners.comment: 2nd and 1st in two Class 6 handicaps; solid run latest; one to consider back down in class

runners.name: Francisco
runners.spotlight: Does a lot wrong in his races (often misses the break and/or pulls too hard) but he has two 7f AW wins to his name, including off this mark over C&D in April; others are more appealing this time.
runners.comment: C&D win off this mark in April but he often misses the break and/or pulls too hard

runners.name: Blue Samuna
runners.spotlight: She didn't progress for Jane Chapple-Hyam and then finished down the field in a 6f handicap at Newmarket on her stable debut 13 days ago; drops in class and returns to a longer trip so not discounted.
runners.comment: She isn't progressing but dropping in class and stepping back up in trip can help

runners.name: Elvetham
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins this year, the latest here (6f) nine days ago; only 3lb higher under a penalty (1lb ahead of the handicapper) and he has form over a mile so this trip should be fine; one to consider.
runners.comment: Three AW wins this year but over 6f; 1lb well in; should make a bold bid

runners.name: Chelio
