runners.spotlight: Twice a runner-up from his six starts, most recently at Goodwood (7f, good to soft) ten weeks ago; he was beaten over 4l on that occasion though and a personal best is required.
runners.comment: Runner-up in two of his six starts but a personal best will be required to win

runners.name: My Dad Tom
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who hasn't matched his 2yo form this year; others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: 0-11 and not progressing; others look more persuasive

runners.name: Oxford Circus
runners.spotlight: He has gone the wrong way on turf in Ireland this season but he did show clear promise on the AW at Dundalk early in the year, including finishing first past the post in a 6f maiden in February (disqualified on a technicality); he has joined a stable who have enjoyed considerable success with similar types and he's a fascinating contender, for all his draw could have been kinder.
runners.comment: Well in on Irish AW form; yard have excelled with similar types; tricky draw though

runners.name: Captive Beauty
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps when finishing a head second in a 7f event at Wolverhampton last month; that form doesn't look overly strong, however, and she has a 2lb higher mark to contend with.
runners.comment: Improved for switch to h'caps when 2nd at Wolverhampton last time; up 2lb in a better race

runners.name: Split Elevens
runners.spotlight: 13 times a winner, three of them over C&D; in good form wheen last seen, including when second off this mark here in June; missed an intended C&D run last month after a controversial administrative error saw him withdrawn; high on the list.
runners.comment: Prolific winner, including three over C&D; arrives in form and he is high on the list

runners.name: Wind Summer
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly at Wolverhampton in March but he ran some sound races on AW over the winter; returns from 136 days off with a visor back on for the first time since his debut.
runners.comment: Patchy overall record; returns from a break with a visor refitted

runners.name: Spirit Of Breeze
runners.spotlight: C&D win last October off 2lb lower; had a wind operation prior to his seasonal return in June; two solid efforts this year and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: C&D win off 2lb lower last October; two solid runs this year following a wind op; chance

runners.name: Midnight's Dream
runners.spotlight: Four solid efforts this summer once fitted with a visor; should remain competitive.
runners.comment: Running well in a visor this summer; should give another good account

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes

runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Dead-heated at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) in May; held his form since and Sunday's second at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) was another solid effort.
runners.comment: 5f win in May and held his form since; should go well once more

runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: 0-12; bits of form on AW earlier in the year but two runs last month were disappointing; revival could be forthcoming now back at 6f and tackling her first classified event; cheekpieces given a go.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden; chance on her winter form now dropped in grade and fitted with headgear

runners.name: Zaltalla
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate but he performed with credit in two classified events here (1m, AW and 7f, good to firm) for this yard last month; should give his running again but not obviously crying out for the drop to 6f.
runners.comment: Placed in classified events here (1m AW and 7f turf) last month; drop to 6f a slight query

runners.name: Pure Passion
runners.spotlight: Promise in maiden/novice company in January; duly stepped forward when winning a 5f classified event at Yarmouth last week; should be fine over the extra furlong but she does have to overcome a 6lb penalty.
runners.comment: Improved when winning a 5f classified race last week; 6f should be fine; penalty to defy
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells

runners.name: Ridger
runners.spotlight: Uncompetitive in three maiden runs this summer (6f, good to firm and 7f, AW); hard to recommend on bare form but he's bred to be smart and it would be no surprise to see marked improvement now dropped to this level; hood discarded this time.
runners.comment: Poor form thus far but he looks a potential big improver now dropped to this level

runners.name: Porfin
runners.spotlight: C&D win in January; not in the same form in three runs since April and minor money perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit but not firing on all cylinders of late; minor money perhaps best hope

runners.name: Roman Spring
runners.spotlight: Won three times in the second half of 2025, including here (5f); mixed bag in 2026 but he is capable at this level and shouldn't be discounted; stable also run Real Gold.
runners.comment: Not hit 2025 heights so far this year but capable at this level; stable run two here

runners.name: Global Effort
runners.spotlight: Not at his best so far this year; returns from five months off with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Not at his best so far this year; returns from five months off with a point to prove

races.race_name: Become A Friend Of Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Shangri La
runners.spotlight: Promise as a 2yo and again when in midfield on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last month; likely to be in the thick of it.
runners.comment: Promise as a 2yo and again on her handicap/seasonal debut last month; one to consider

runners.name: Dove Tale
runners.spotlight: Unfancied for her sole 2yo run (7f); sent off at 11-1 for last week's return to action at Kempton (1m3f) where she was a well-beaten third; can do better and the addition of a hood can help.
runners.comment: Raced freely when a 7.5l third at Kempton (1m3f) last week; unexposed and a hood can help
runners.owner: G Strawbridge, Ms R Hood & R Evans

runners.name: Walking On Stars
runners.spotlight: Shaped nicely on her Southwell debut (7f) last month and took a step forward when fourth of eight at Wolverhampton (9.5f) one week later; still capable of better and she's more appealing than many.
runners.comment: Two promising runs over shorter; still has more to offer and she is high on the list
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Neswick
runners.spotlight: 28-1 for her C&D debut in April but she finished with a flourish to take third; others have achieved more but she is unexposed and could leave that initial run well behind; yard in form.
runners.comment: Promising third over C&D on debut in April; more to come and her yard are going well

runners.name: Blue Hill
runners.spotlight: She has shown some promise in her two runs (1m, good to firm and 1m3f, AW) this summer but she will need to produce plenty more to take this.
runners.comment: Some promise in two runs this summer but others have achieved more

runners.name: Paraone
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to five winners including Paloma Ohe (German 6.5f/7f including 2yo Listed; RPR 94), Expresso James (French 7f-1m4f including AW) and Panjo (German 7.5f-1m1f); dam Listed-placed 11.5f winner (89), sister to 6f Group 2 winner Pomellato; stable not known for winning newcomers.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 5 winners out of Listed-placed winner; yard not known for winning newcomers

runners.name: Champagne Beau
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in two 1m Windsor novices this summer; opposable.
runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten in two 1m Windsor novices this summer; opposable

runners.name: Oklahoma Dream
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two runs 199 days apart; bred to do better at some point but that progress may come when handicapping.
runners.comment: Latest Salisbury fifth has thrown up winners but she needs improvement to take this
runners.owner: D Macauliffe, A Don & G Rutter

runners.name: Protectrix
runners.spotlight: 50-1 and finished well beaten on her debut at Southwell (7f) three weeks ago; new trip not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Well beaten in 7f maiden on last month's debut (50-1); new trip but still looks vulnerable

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap

runners.name: South West
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt with an easy win in a novice at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month; this is tougher off revised mark on nursery debut but he has a progressive profile and is bred to be useful; key player.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Catterick and he's open to more progress on nursery debut; key player

runners.name: Miss Moneypit
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism on nursery debut here (5f, good to firm) last month and the step back up 6f seemed to backfire on her return visit 12 days ago; could resume her progress back at this trip and she's out of an AW winner; in the mix.
runners.comment: Won turf here last month and the step back up to 6f seemed to backfire latest; in the mix

runners.name: Wolf's Gallop
runners.spotlight: Placed in novice events at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) and Windsor (5f, good to firm) before a close fourth of six on nursery debut at Leicester (9-4 favourite) two weeks ago; still unexposed after only four starts but he needs to find something extra on this switch to AW.
runners.comment: Creditable efforts in his last three runs but he needs to find more on this AW debut
runners.owner: Fairies At The Bottom Of The Garden Ltd

runners.name: From Me To You
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in first three starts and he beat only one rival in the Super Sprint at Newbury (40-1) last time; this is more realistic on nursery debut but he needs blinkers to make a big difference.
runners.comment: No closer than sixth so far and needs blinkers to make a big difference on nursery debut

runners.name: Viking Barbie
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise with her placed efforts at Salisbury and Sandown (both at 5f on good) but she flopped with a 10l defeat in a Beverley novice last month; still early days but she needs to bounce back with a personal best on this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Flopped at Beverley last time and she has a bit to prove on nursery debut

runners.name: Sultan Darius
runners.spotlight: Single-figure prices but he was beaten 5l, 6l and 7l in three maiden/novice events over sprint trips; now goes handicapping with a hood added but he needs a transformation on AW debut.
runners.comment: Well held in maiden/novice events and needs a transformation on nursery debut; hood added

runners.name: Secret Rival
runners.spotlight: Her best effort in novice/maiden events was a 4l sixth of ten at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on her second start; out of a 5f 2yo winner but she struggled at Chepstow last time and has something to prove on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Down the field in maiden/novice events and needs to show a lot more on nursery debut

runners.name: Stoney Wood
runners.spotlight: Didn't show much in his first two starts but he shaped with promise when fifth of 12 in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) last month; half-brother to a 5f Listed winner and he's an interesting contender dropped in trip on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Showed promise at Southwell last time and he needs watching in market on nursery debut

runners.name: Beautiful Effort
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in her first two starts before a well-held fifth of nine in a novice at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; needs improvement now switched to a nursery but she showed plenty of speed last time and shaped as though this drop to 5f could suit.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly and she's a possible improver dropped to 5f on nursery debut; watch market
